properties.name: ruslo.admin-ui.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the admin UI when the ruslo-admin-ui module is on the classpath

properties.name: ruslo.database-dialect
properties.description: SQL dialect of the database; detected from JDBC metadata if not set

properties.name: ruslo.history.enabled
properties.description: Whether to store process state transitions in the xs_process_state_hist table

properties.name: ruslo.database-migration.enabled
properties.description: Whether to run the built-in database schema migration when the engine starts

properties.name: ruslo.dispatcher.enabled
properties.description: Whether to start the dispatcher and register the instance when the engine starts; if disabled, the instance does not run processes in the background

properties.name: ruslo.dispatcher.max-interval
properties.description: Maximum interval between polls for ready processes, used when there is no work

properties.name: ruslo.dispatcher.min-interval
properties.description: Minimum interval between polls for ready processes, used when there is work

properties.name: ruslo.dispatcher.instance-timeout
properties.description: How long an instance without heartbeats stays registered before its leases are released, in database time; must be at least four heartbeat intervals

properties.name: ruslo.workers
properties.description: Worker settings. The key is the worker id; the key default is an alias for DEFAULT

properties.name: ruslo.logging.mdc.correlation-id-key
properties.description: MDC key for the process correlation id

properties.name: ruslo.logging.mdc.process-id-key
properties.description: MDC key for the process id

properties.name: ruslo.logging.mdc.process-type-key
properties.description: MDC key for the process type

properties.name: ruslo.workers.*.execution-mode
properties.description: Step execution mode: transactional or non_transactional. The DEFAULT worker must be transactional because it runs await handlers

properties.name: ruslo.workers.*.max-concurrency
properties.description: Maximum number of steps running concurrently

values.description: The step runs in the engine transaction
The step runs outside the engine transaction, at least once
